system.description: • Effect: Vancian slot-based casting per the Magus Spells Per Day table below, from a narrower Magus spell list focused on self-buffs, melee-enhancing effects, and direct-damage spells rather than Wizard's full utility breadth. DC = 10 + half your Magus level (minimum 1) + Intelligence modifier — see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula. No spell attack rolls — all harmful or debuffing spells require a save.
